connector.name: three.ws Copy Trading
connector.registryDescription: Manage copy-trade follows - follow leaders, tune sizing and guard rules, and track fees owed.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package copy-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
env.description: Your three.ws bearer credential — an API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) or OAuth access token. Every copy-trade subscription, intent, and fee is scoped to the account it identifies. Required for all tools except a leader's public aggregate earnings. Mint one at https://three.ws/settings/api-keys. Treat like cash.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the copy-trading endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live copy-trading reads and writes.
